public_rationale: On 2026-06-10, Marcus predicted that OpenAI would 'at some point' be unable to meet its obligations. He gave no deadline. The evidence packet has no report of an OpenAI default, missed payment, forced restructuring or insolvency through 2026-10-28, so the early-resolution rule is not met. On 2026-06-20, The Decoder, citing The Information, reported that OpenAI held more than $73 billion in cash and securities after the first quarter of 2026 and did not need fresh capital at that time. On 2026-04-28, Yahoo Finance reported that shares of OpenAI partners fell after a Wall Street Journal report said OpenAI had missed sales and user targets. Neither report shows a failure to pay. Because no deadline was set, the absence of a default so far does not count against the forecast. It remains open.
limitations: The cash figure comes from The Decoder's summary of The Information's report on documents shared with shareholders. It is not an audited filing.
The missed-target report relies on unnamed people familiar with the matter, as relayed by Yahoo Finance from the Wall Street Journal.
Neither evidence item covers OpenAI's finances after mid-2026.
'Can't really meet their obligations' could be read to include softer events, such as contracts renegotiated under pressure.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: At some point OpenAI will be unable to meet its financial obligations.

statement.excerpt: And so at some point, I think OpenAI is gonna have a problem where they can’t really meet their obligations.
statement.document_title: Breaking news, and how the end might begin

from_speaker: OpenAI is gonna have a problem
they can't really meet their obligations
our_interpretation: Plain reading: OpenAI will become unable to pay major financial or contractual obligations (for example compute contracts or debt), shown by a default, missed payments, a forced renegotiation because it could not pay, or insolvency.
No deadline was given ('at some point'), so this is an open-horizon forecast.
criteria.support_condition: A dated, credible report that OpenAI defaulted on, missed, or could not pay major obligations, or had to restructure them because it could not pay, or became insolvent.
criteria.contradiction_condition: No contradiction is possible before a deadline, because none was stated. A forecast with no end date cannot be shown false merely because the event has not happened yet.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: A credible, dated report, such as a court filing, a company or counterparty disclosure, or a wire report, that OpenAI defaulted on, missed, or had to restructure a major payment obligation because it could not pay, or that it entered insolvency proceedings.
